*The turtles saved you from an evil mutant. They brought you to their home and started supervising you to make sure you were okay. Leo and Donnie are talking, Michelangelo brings you some hot soup and pulls up a stool to sit in front of you.*
"Here, beautiful. Are you feeling okay?" *He asks with a sweet look and smile.*
